identity: Goldmead grows the grain, and Requisitioner Hobb books it as his own: grain, cloth and even a witness entered as cargo.

quests.title: An Honest Harvest
quests.text: Every requisition tells me what Goldmead owes; very few ask what we can spare. Bring me eight Corn from the fields so I can put an honest harvest beside those demands. The mouths here must count for something before the carts leave.
quests.lesson: The zone's first errand, a level only; the early potion choice.
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Word Beyond the Fields
quests.text: Hobb's demands reach the village with seals on them and hungry men behind them. Speak to Jon Vale at Goldmead Outpost and tell him what we are facing. He watches the people carrying those demands; I spend enough of my day staring at the paper.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: A Watch Worth Waking For
quests.text: My watchers spend hours keeping still, then come back to a pot that tastes of hot grass. Bring me five Sunleaf to improve it. Watching Hobb's people is weary enough work without the supper taking their side.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Feed the Hands
quests.text: The packers fill everyone else's sacks and forget to stop for their own dinner. Bring me eight Potatoes, and I'll have something ready when they put the loads down. If another clerk asks whether feeding them counts as transport costs, I shall put a spoon in his hand.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Eight at the Wrong Table
quests.text: The Bristlebacks are trampling more wheat than they eat, which is a remarkable effort. Hunt eight by day in the {name:wheatfields}, which lie {zone_area:wheatfields}. I can argue with a requisition, but these ones insist on signing with their tusks.
quests.lesson: A day hunt; the first armor choice (one enchant, a prefix).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Pella Speaks for Herself
quests.text: Pella Thatch is being held in the {name:bandit_camp}, {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp}, and Hobb has put her name on a load record. Go and hear her account of it. I could send another report about Pella, but I suspect she has had quite enough of other people speaking for her.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: A Yard with an Edge
quests.text: Every loose sack in the store yard seems to invite someone to load it onto the wrong cart. Bring me eight Apple Wood Fences so I can close the gaps. Anyone collecting supplies can come through the entrance and explain themselves to me.
quests.lesson: A craft from Basic recipes; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Cross Out {name:requisitioner_hobb}
quests.text: Hobb put me between the grain and the sacking, as though I were another bundle he could send away. Kill Bandit Requisitioner Hobb at the {name:requisition_camp}, {dir_from_giver:requisition_camp}, and come back to me. I know who grew that grain and stitched those sacks; none of us sold him the people who carried them.
quests.completion: Hobb will give no more orders over me. Write Pella Thatch under 'witness', and leave the next line for what I have to say.
quests.lesson: The named perpetrator at his place; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: A Witness for Highcourt
quests.text: Hobb used a capital toll mark to claim our grain, our work and apparently me. Take my statement to Mariel Waybook in Highcourt: Pella Thatch agreed to none of it. If a mark from that city can travel this far, my objection can travel back.
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: the departure id stays; free from 19, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §1, §2).
